title: AI Process Analysis and Automation Design

questions.question: Why should AI automation start with process analysis?
options: Because automation can make an unclear process faster but less reliable
Because process maps are never useful
Because no human fallback is needed
questions.explanation: The lesson starts with process understanding before tool selection.

questions.question: Which signal is part of this lesson?
questions.explanation: Manual handoffs often reveal automation and redesign opportunities.

questions.question: What does the Python artifact produce?
options: A ranked automation triage plan with controls and rationale
questions.explanation: The artifact ranks process scenarios and recommends controls.

questions.question: Which control belongs to this lesson?
questions.explanation: Human fallback protects exception handling and accountable judgment.

questions.question: When should an automation idea receive stronger review?
options: When exception volume, automation risk, handoffs, or high value potential are present
Only when the process is already automated
questions.explanation: These signals require controls before piloting automation.

questions.question: What should teams know before piloting AI automation?
options: Process map, value check, exception log, and fallback plan
questions.explanation: These controls make automation pilots safer and more useful.
